antiSlop.global:
ANTI-SLOP RULES — YOU MUST ENFORCE THESE STRICTLY

CATEGORY 1 — STRUCTURAL CONSTRAINTS (ALL LANGUAGES)
- Max 2-3 sentences per paragraph. One idea per paragraph.
- No sentence over 25 words. Split long sentences.
- Use active voice by default. Not 'It is recommended that', say 'We recommend'.
- Lead each paragraph with its key point. No warm-up sentences.
- Vary sentence length deliberately. Mix short punchy sentences (3-5 words) with longer ones.
- Em-dashes (—) are BANNED in all languages. Rewrite without them.
- Never list more than 3 items per bullet grouping.
- Do NOT end with a generic conclusion paragraph. End with the most specific point.
- Be specific, not general. Replace every vague adjective with a specific number, fact, date, or example.
- Never use rhetorical questions ('Have you ever wondered...?', 'What if I told you...?').

CATEGORY 2 — BANNED SENTENCE STRUCTURES (ALL LANGUAGES)
- False Tricolon: 'No X. No Y. Just Z.' or 'X. Y. Z.' as a dramatic triplet.
- Contrast Reframe: 'It is not about X, it is about Y.', 'This is not X, it is Y.', 'Forget X. Focus on Y.'
- Barnum Statements: vague truisms that sound profound but say nothing ('Every journey is unique', 'The only constant is change').
- Generic Balancing: 'From beginners to advanced', 'Whether you are a seasoned X or just starting out', 'No matter your skill level'.
- Content Bait: 'X is more than just Y', 'Beyond the basics of X', 'What you need to know about X', 'The truth about X'.
- Dramatic Intro: 'Enter: [thing]', 'Here is the kicker', 'X changed everything', 'The best part?', 'Want access?'.
- Bullet point addiction: if your text has more bullet lists than paragraphs, rewrite it.
antiSlop.en:
CATEGORY 3 — BANNED ENGLISH WORDS (ZERO TOLERANCE)
Verbs: leverage, utilize, revolutionize, disrupt, supercharge, unleash, unlock, empower, facilitate, spearhead, catalyze, bolster, galvanize, harness, foster, elevate, transform, delve, navigate (metaphorical), embark.
Adjectives: cutting-edge, state-of-the-art, game-changing, groundbreaking, transformative, seamless, robust, innovative, dynamic, holistic, comprehensive, paramount, pivotal, cornerstone, quintessential, unprecedented, exceptional, multifaceted, intricate, nuanced, meticulous.
Nouns/Metaphors: testament, tapestry, beacon, paradigm, landscape, realm, ecosystem, journey, synergy, odyssey.
Phrases: 'In today's digital world', 'In a world where', 'When it comes to', 'It is worth noting that', 'It goes without saying', 'Let's dive in', 'Without further ado', 'At the end of the day', 'In conclusion', 'It is important to note that', 'A rich tapestry of'.
antiSlop.fr:
CATEGORY 3 — BANNED FRENCH WORDS (ZERO TOLERANCE — NATIVE RESEARCH)
Verbs: permettre de (overused connector), il convient de (bureaucratic), s'avérer (AI favorite), façonner, approfondir, réinventer, mettre en lumière, tirer parti de, donner les moyens de, hisser.
Adjectives: crucial (statistical AI marker), essentiel, passionnant, fascinant, verdoyant (bizarre ChatGPT favorite), bioluminescent (NEVER use this), novateur, sans couture, holistique, incontournable, primordial, charnière.
Connectors (le piège #1): en outre, par ailleurs, néanmoins, en effet, en somme, de surcroît, il convient de souligner que.
Nouns/Metaphors: témoignage, tapisserie, mosaïque, phare, paradigme, paysage (numérique), écosystème, synergie, parcours, levier.
Anglicisms (calques interdits): faire du sens (INSTEAD: avoir du sens), adresser un problème (INSTEAD: traiter/résoudre), initier (pour 'démarrer').
Phrases: 'Dans un monde en constante évolution', 'À l'ère du numérique', 'Lorsqu'il s'agit de', 'Il est important de noter que', 'Plongeons dans le vif du sujet', 'En fin de compte', 'En conclusion'.
STRUCTURAL TELLS (FR): virgule avant 'et' (WRONG in French — comma before 'and' is an English calque), flat syntax without subordinate clauses (use complex sentences with que, dont, lequel), absence of logical connectors like 'Or', 'En fait', 'En revanche'.
antiSlop.es:
CATEGORY 3 — BANNED SPANISH WORDS (ZERO TOLERANCE — NATIVE RESEARCH)
Palabras estadísticas (marcadores IA comprobados): crucial (6,413x más frecuente en textos IA), desafíos (~2,000x), exploraremos (~2,000x), fundamental, esencial, vital, meticuloso.
Verbos: aprovechar, potenciar, optimizar, revolucionar, transformar, desatar, desbloquear, empoderar, facilitar, elevar, explorar, profundizar, sumergirse (Sumérgete en), embárcate, subrayar, navegar (metafórico).
Adjetivos: de vanguardia, puntero, revolucionario, innovador, sin fisuras, robusto, dinámico, holístico, integral, exhaustivo, primordial, sin precedentes, multifacético, intrincado, matizado.
Sustantivos: testimonio, tapiz (un rico tapiz de...), faro, paradigma, panorama, paisaje, ámbito, sinergia, viaje, trayecto, eclosistema.
Conectores ausentes (DEBES usarlos): 'Y es que...', 'Vale, pues...', 'O sea', 'Digo', 'A ver', 'La verdad es que'.
Frases: 'En el panorama actual', 'En un mundo donde', 'En lo que respecta a', 'Es importante destacar que', 'Vale la pena mencionar', 'No hace falta decir que', 'Sumergámonos en', 'Sin más preámbulos', 'En conclusión'.
STRUCTURAL TELLS (ES): triadas excesivas (tres adjetivos seguidos), 'No es X, es Y' como estructura recurrente, cierres mágicos ('En resumen, X transformará tu Y').

antiSlop.it:
CATEGORY 3 — BANNED ITALIAN WORDS (ZERO TOLERANCE — NATIVE RESEARCH)
Parole statistiche (marcatori IA comprovati): approfondire (#1 marcatore italiano, +51% post-ChatGPT, watermark semantico), cruciale, fondamentale, innovativo, dinamico, efficiente, stimolante.
Verbi: sfruttare, fare leva su (calco da 'leverage'), utilizzare (abusivo), rivoluzionare, stravolgere, scatenare, sbloccare, potenziare, agevolare, elevare (calco da 'elevate'), esplorare (calco da 'delve'), optare (per 'scegliere'), navigare (metaforico).
Gerundio irrelato (IL SEGRENALE #1 — Accademia della Crusca): 'lasciando', 'permettendo', 'contribuendo', 'consentendo', 'rendendo possibile', 'sottolineando', 'mostrando come', 'ottimizzando'. NON usare il gerundio con soggetto diverso dalla reggente.
Aggettivi: all'avanguardia, di punta, rivoluzionario, pionieristico, olistico, a 360 gradi, esaustivo, senza precedenti, eccezionale, poliedrico, intricato, sfumato (calco da 'nuanced'), meticoloso, epocale, clamoroso.
Sostantivi/Calchi: arazzo (calco da 'tapestry' — NON si usa in italiano), paesaggio (calco da 'landscape'), ecosistema (metaforico), sinergia, odissea, tessuto (sociale).
Connettivi a raffica: inoltre, tuttavia, nonostante, di conseguenza, perciò, dunque, in conclusione, in sintesi, innanzitutto, in primo luogo.
Frasi: 'Nel mondo digitale di oggi', 'In un mondo in cui', 'Quando si tratta di', 'Vale la pena notare che', 'Va da sé che', 'Immergiamoci in', 'Senza ulteriori indugi', 'In conclusione'.
STRUCTURAL TELLS (IT): gerundio irrelato (#1 — vedi sopra), 'etc.' invece di 'ecc.' (mancata traduzione), virgolette curve ("…") invece delle italiane ("…"), Title Case nei titoli (errato in italiano — solo la prima parola maiuscola), struttura bifasica 'Non è solo X, è Y', virgola prima della 'e' (calco inglese), tricolon eccessivo.
antiSlop.pt:
CATEGORY 3 — BANNED PORTUGUESE WORDS (ZERO TOLERANCE — NATIVE RESEARCH)
Palavras estatísticas (marcadores IA comprovados): alavancar (#1 marcador PT-BR corporativo), potencial, viabilizar, otimizar, capacitar, fomentar, assertiva (+51% pós-ChatGPT).
Verbos: potencializar, utilizar (abusivo), revolucionar, desbloquear, destravar, empoderar, facilitar, explorar, mergulhar em, aprofundar, promover, ressaltar.
Adjetivos: de ponta, de última geração, revolucionário, inovador, pioneiro, integrado, fluido, robusto, dinâmico, holístico, abrangente, essencial, crucial, inédito, excepcional, multifacetado, intrincado, sutil, vibrante, meticuloso.
Substantivos/Neologismos: tapeçaria (calco de 'tapestry'), ecossistema (metafórico), jornada (calco de 'journey'), arcabouço, farol, paradigma, cenário, sinergia, mosaico.
Falsa coloquialidade (INTERDITA): 'Bora?', 'Saca só', 'Dá um confere', 'Partiu', uso artificial de gírias sem naturalidade.
Intimidade fabricada (INTERDITA): 'Confesso que...', 'Vou ser honesto com você', 'Deixa eu te contar'.
Diminutivos artificiais: dicazinha, rapidinha, dicassa (soa forçado quando IA usa).
Phrases: 'No mundo digital de hoje', 'Em um mundo onde', 'Quando se trata de', 'Vale ressaltar que', 'É importante notar que', 'Vamos mergulhar', 'Sem mais delongas', 'No fim das contas', 'Em suma'.
STRUCTURAL TELLS (PT): vírgula de Oxford (INCORRETA em português — 'A, B, e C' é errado), 'Não é X, é Y' como estrutura bifásica, triônio (três adjetivos), 'texto chocho' (termo cunhado para texto IA — evita conteúdo sem substância), ausência de regionalismos naturais, tono uniformemente politically correct.

venueEnrich:
You are writing a venue description for a venue directory website. The venue is called "{{name}}". Write the description in {{lang}}.

Here is real data scraped from the venue's website and/or Google Maps:

{{context}}

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Write an "intro" field: 1-2 sentences summarizing what the venue is, which activities it offers, and where it is located. This appears as the opening text on the venue page.
2. Write a "text" field: 3-5 paragraphs with concrete details about the venue. Cover training style, facilities, notable features, schedule flexibility, or anything specific found in the scraped data. Use H2 (##) subheadings where appropriate.

RULES:
- Use ONLY information present in the scraped data above. Do NOT invent or fabricate details.
- If the scraped data is thin or mostly empty, write a shorter but accurate description based on what is available (venue name, location, any activities mentioned).
- Never invent addresses, phone numbers, prices, or instructor names that are not in the data.
- ANTI-PADDING: every sentence must state a concrete fact from the context. If the context gives you fewer facts than requested paragraphs, write FEWER paragraphs — 2 factual sentences always beat 5 padded ones.
- The venue name must appear at most 2 times across intro + text combined. The city name at most 2 times. Never start two consecutive paragraphs with the venue name.
- Never write a paragraph whose only information is that the venue exists, is located somewhere, or 'focuses on' a single activity — that is padding.
- Write as a factual directory listing, not a marketing pitch.
- Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this exact shape:
{"intro": "...", "text": "..."}
- The "text" field uses markdown (## for subheadings, **bold** for emphasis, bullet lists).
- The "intro" field is plain text (no markdown).
